Environmental conservation and biodiversity restoration
Through Project Prakriti, VSSL has taken a proactive stance on environmental restoration and green development.

We developed dense Miyawaki forests in three major cities across Punjab—Amritsar, Patiala and Ludhiana — leading to the plantation of over 1.15 lakh trees with a target of 35,000 more in the next few months.
Complementing this afforestation drive were park restoration efforts and greenbelt development projects that enhanced urban greenery.
Furthermore, environmental awareness campaigns and exposure visits were organised to instil ecological responsibility among students and local communities.
